scope: Calendar-order closure pass from 14 November: local exact namesakes and open name histories for 14–15 November in LV, LT and EE.

records.name: Undalgs
records.facts_used: Neatkarīgā Rīta Avīze No. 118, 22 May 1997, Aiva Kanepone, “Daudz laimes Zauram, Rudjardam, Tāllidai, Metaksijai un parējiem!!!”: a Salaspils bearer received the name, slightly changed by his parents, from the name of Viesalgi village in the Kuldīga area; a younger namesake’s mother took it from a television programme. Text read in the reader; images are library-access only.
records.reason: Exact-spelling dated source on the name’s formation.
records.uncertainties: Single bearer’s account; the exact parental alteration is not described. The bearer is not named in the widget.

records.name: Vincentina
records.facts_used: Rigasche Stadtblätter No. 38, 19 Sep 1874, “Aus den Kirchengemeinden”, Aufgeboten, Petri- u. Dom-K.: “Kath. Vincentina Gembitzky” (scan visually checked). LV-SILINS90: Vincentīn/a, -e feminine of Vincentins (Rēzekne 1877); Vincentins → Vincentijs; Vincentijs < Latin vincens.
records.reason: Exact unaccented spelling attested in a dated record; the dictionary family is stated separately without assigning its dates to this spelling.
records.uncertainties: German-language list; the record documents use of the spelling, not a separate origin. Vincentīna’s 1877 date is not transferred.
